name: Reconciliation Transaction
definition: Totals performed during the reconciliation period, for a certain type of transaction.

ReconciliationIdentification.name: Reconciliation Identification
ReconciliationIdentification.definition: Unique identification of the reconciliation period between the acceptor and the acquirer. This identification might be linked to the identification of the settlement for further verification by the merchant.

TransactionType.name: Transaction Type
TransactionType.definition: Identification of the type of transaction.

TotalNumber.name: Total Number
TotalNumber.definition: Total number of transactions during a reconciliation period.

CumulativeAmount.name: Cumulative Amount
CumulativeAmount.definition: Total amount of a collection of transactions.

ClosePeriod.name: Close Period
ClosePeriod.definition: Indicates if the exchange requires a closure of the reconciliation period.

CardPaymentTotal.name: Card Payment Total
CardPaymentTotal.definition: Specifies the card payments which are part of the transaction reconciliation.
